notes: Patterns are modelled on what gets the most plays. Every word Julian publishes is his own: never copy another teacher's title, script or signature lines.

Insight Timer titles: no category words (Guided Meditation, Meditation, Music) and no teacher name, but do give the minutes and the benefit (top teachers have retitled their tracks this way). Spotify titles: lead with the format keyword, then the benefit.

Insight Timer pays a play after 2 minutes or half the track, whichever comes first, and pays a return rate bonus (25 to 30% of teacher income). Hook early, put tips on how to use the track in the description, invite a return tomorrow, upload regularly.
Cover all six bands of the app's length filter over time: 0 to 5, 6 to 10, 11 to 15, 16 to 20, 21 to 30 and 30 plus minutes.
Insight Timer requires a real human voice for narration. Voice clones and text to speech are not permitted. Use Record mode for anything going to Insight Timer.

playData.summary: Of 77.65M verified plays across 26 high play Insight Timer tracks, 75% are sleep. Three yoga nidra for sleep tracks by one teacher hold 43%. Sleep plays sit at 20 minutes or longer (93% of sleep plays with a known length, median about 26 minutes). Daytime plays sit at 10 to 15 minutes (84% of daytime plays, median about 10 minutes). Anxiety, sleep and mornings were Insight Timer's three most searched terms in 2020.
playData.caveat: Play counts come from search engine snapshots of insighttimer.com track pages (undated, so read them as at least this many). There is no official all time chart, so this is the verified high play set, not the true top 40.
